name: Window Nativizer
description: Rounds window corners to GNOME's radius and adds a shadow only where no compositor, frame or client draws one. Windows that already look native — libadwaita or libhandy applications, or Qt applications with an Adwaita decoration plugin — are left alone. It decides that from the libraries a process maps (/proc/<pid>/maps); a wrong guess is corrected by picking the window once. Nothing about your windows leaves the machine, and the only thing stored is the rule you set.
